name: Giant Rats
notes: 2d6 rats. A bite on a natural 20 also gives disease (Poisoned).

name: Goblin Band
notes: 1d6 goblins ambush from cover.

name: Skeleton Guard
notes: Mindless. Resistant to piercing and edged, vulnerable to blunt. Immune to Sleep, Charmed, Poisoned, Frightened.

name: Orc Patrol
notes: 1d4 warriors demanding blood or toll.

name: Ghoul
notes: A hit forces a Body save or Paralyzed. Immune as skeletons.

name: Giant Spider
notes: A hit forces a Body save or Poisoned. Webs: Dodge save or stuck 1d4 rounds.

name: Rival Adventurers
notes: 1d4+1 NPCs of the party's Level, one per class, after the same treasure. Roll Reaction.

name: Dark Cultist
notes: Casts Cause Light Wounds for 1d8 on a touch. Chaotic.

name: Ogre
notes: Heavy club.

name: Wight
notes: A hit forces a Body save or Injured. Resistant to all but blunt, silver, and magic. Immune as skeletons.

name: Troll
notes: Regains 3 HP each round unless the damage was fire.

name: Young Dragon
notes: On first sight, Will save or Frightened. Breath once per fight: 6d6 fire in 30 ft, Dodge for half. Immune to fire. Sleeps on a hoard.

name: Gargoyle
notes: Claws. Flies. Construct: immune to Sleep, Charmed, Poisoned, Frightened. Resistant to all but magic weapons.

name: Engine Guardian
notes: A gargoyle grown fat on the coffer's magic. Won't leave the engine room.

name: Restless Sailor
notes: Chilling touch. Harmed only by magic or silver. Passive unless the watch is disturbed.

name: Animated Rigging
notes: Grab: Dodge save or stuck 1d4 rounds. Immune to Charmed and Frightened. Fire frees anyone caught.

name: Wick the Pseudodragon
notes: Sting: Body save or Asleep. Flies. A friend, not a fight, once fed.

name: Gargoyle Chieftain
notes: Claws. Flies. As a gargoyle, but proud, and open to tribute.

name: Harpy
notes: Talons. Flies. Song: Will save or walk toward the harpy, even off a ledge, until struck.

name: Wraith-Librarian
notes: Chilling touch, Body save or Injured. Harmed only by magic or silver. Can hush a caster for 1d4 rounds on a failed Will save.

name: Clockwork Sentinel
notes: Blade. Construct: immune to Sleep, Charmed, Poisoned, Frightened. Vulnerable to lightning.

name: Thalros the Cloud Giant
notes: Slam. Thunder-call: a 20 ft burst, Dodge save or 3d6 and shoved to the deck's edge.
